# GitHub Copilot instructions

Follow the repository-wide rules in [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md).
Before substantial Qt work, consult the matching `skills/<skill-name>/SKILL.md` and its relevant references.
Use `qt-qml` and `qt-qml-review` for QML changes; `qt-cpp-review` for C++ review; `qt-cmake-project` for build-system changes; `qt-ui-design` for UI/UX work; and the matching test/documentation/profiling skills as applicable.
The project's KDE Plasma 6, Qt 6, current Kirigami, no-versioned-QML-import, semantic-theme-color, Kirigami.Units, and qmllint requirements are mandatory and override generic skill advice.
